method: Three complete pinned files read. AST-extracted original check_false_positives/remove_duplicates functions executed with original Jaccard/UnionFind and minimal in-memory Dataset filter/map adapter; no fingerprint or full pipeline execution.
findings: Verification updates cluster_column but never __duplicate__; removal filters stale __duplicate__. Three synthetic candidates with mutually disjoint token sets: verification emits no parents and singleton clusters, yet removal retains only original root and discards other2. Reproduced original function bodies, adapter scope explicit.

Initial SimHash cluster removes root self-assignments from parents. assign marks only nonroots duplicate; verification filters by duplicate flag and omits retained root. A two-member candidate cluster therefore presents only1member for verification, which cannot be compared to retained root. Source observation.

Both initial Hamming clustering and Jaccard verified-pair clustering use UnionFind connected components; transitive chains do not prove retained root matches every member. Local library all-pairs grouping requirement remains distinct.

Short/empty texts below token minimum get all-zero signatures rather than being filtered. Such unrelated texts become identical signature candidates; stale-flag defect can defeat optional verification. Full embedding runtime unexecuted.

Config validation explicitly checks num_bucket > bit_diff but lacks positive f/num_bucket/bit_diff constraints. model_post_init division by floor(f/num_bucket) can reach zero for f<num_bucket. Actual Pydantic lifecycle not executed.

create_permutations uses _x>0 without decrementing _x across masks; it emits ordered permutations of fixed blocks, potentially redundant candidates. No missed-neighbor claim without exhaustive real bitarray test.

Reviewed test_permute uses random fingerprint at default settings and checks inverse permutation; it does not exercise full assign/verify/filter pipeline or stale flags. Wider component test file remains unread.

result.scope: Original two functions and original Jaccard/UnionFind; minimal in-memory filter/map adapter replaces HuggingFace Dataset, no fingerprint or full pipeline run.

limits: No full upstream pytest, actual HuggingFace Dataset, Pydantic config, NumPy/bitarray fingerprint run. No production changes. pHash/ASAN deferred.
